_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-of-72-window coil regime makes HOLD the skilled graded call; UP requires fed_liquidity >20 and etf_flows turning positive, neither of which is present.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see upward gravitational pull toward Disbelief, but analyst explicitly anchors to HOLD with structural caveats while narrative implies accumulation is underway; the analyst's higher trust weight and base-rate discipline carry the verdict.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score climbs to 63+ (Hope band) with fed_liquidity >20 and etf_flows turning positive
